mark.name: Cut F
mark.rule: One solid angular initial; only straight edges. No circle, curl, spiral, koru, arc or curve. Path commands restricted to M, V, H, L and Z.

geometry.unit: 1 viewBox unit; stem 16 units wide, arms 14 units thick, clipped tips 6 units
geometry.note: Upper arm longer than the middle arm. Exact masters: docs/assets/brand/faktor-symbol*.svg; IDE slots use the bare symbol with the host's own color behavior.

state.rule: Every treatment includes text and a shape. Brand ochre is not success; never rely on color alone.

type.productHost: inherit the IDE reading font; marketing type never enters the product widget

clearSpace: Keep H/4 clear space on all sides of the visible artwork (H = visible symbol height). Empty viewBox padding is not clear space.

voice.campaign: Make the change. Show the evidence.
voice.pending: One required result is missing. Completion stays pending.
voice.failure: Required check failed. Inspect the result.
voice.unavailable: Verification unavailable. No verdict for this claim.
voice.mismatch: Landed state differs from the verified candidate.
voice.cost: Recorded spend, rework and final basis. No invented savings or public prices.
